title: Streaming crypto I/O: fix accumulate-then-process model
description:
The current design forces a write-all-then-read-all model. read() auto-finalizes the session, a static 1MB outbuf is pre-allocated for every cipher operation, and the wolfssl CBC/GCM providers accumulate the entire input in ctx->inbuf before encrypting anything. This prevents interleaved write/read streaming, wastes kernel memory, and means a 16-byte AES-CBC operation pays a 1MB allocation tax.

Fix requires changes at three layers:
1. UAPI: add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE ioctl so finalization is explicit, not implicit on first read(). read() without prior FINALIZE drains whatever update() has produced so far.
2. Framework (fd.c): replace static 1MB outbuf with a dynamic buffer; implement FINALIZE handler; allow write/read interleaving.
3. Providers: wolfssl AES-CBC and AES-GCM must process complete blocks in update() and hold only the tail for finalize(). Hash/HMAC/CMAC providers should already be correct — audit to confirm.

Both UAPI and provider API are in scope. Tests and DESIGN.md must be updated to match.
